newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine economy minister's agenda in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Argentine economy minister's agenda in Europe.

text.p: The following are highlights of the agenda of Argentine Economy Minister Roque Fernandez's trip to Europe next week, where he will participate in the World Economic Forum:
Jan 29 - 1700 - Meeting with Swiss bankers organized by Europa Club
Jan 30 - All day conference in Paris on Latin American economies, including 0930 round table discussion attended by Fernandez and his Brazilian counterpart, Pedro Malan.
Jan 31 - 1115 - Fernandez will make brief presentation to Davos forum
- 1300 - Private lunch offered by Jean Pascal
- 2015 - First meeting of members of Private
Feb 1 - 0800 - Working breakfast with investment foundation
- 1300 - Members of Private Gathering of the Global
- 1645 - Fernandez to address session on National
Feb 2 - 0845 - Third session of members of the Private Gathering of the Global Agenda.
